title: Detailed trumpet
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Bell of the trumpet -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='50' rx='14' ry='20' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='50' rx='10' ry='16' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='50' rx='5' ry='9' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <!-- Bell rim -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='50' rx='14' ry='20' fill='none' stroke='#FF8F00' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- Main lead pipe going from bell to mouthpiece -->
  <rect x='30' y='46' width='38' height='8' rx='3' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <!-- Shaded bottom of lead pipe -->
  <rect x='30' y='50' width='38' height='4' rx='2' fill='#E6A800'/>
  <!-- Valve casing assembly -->
  <rect x='45' y='38' width='22' height='24' rx='4' fill='#FFCA28'/>
  <!-- Three valve pistons -->
  <rect x='47' y='30' width='5' height='12' rx='2' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <rect x='53.5' y='28' width='5' height='14' rx='2' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <rect x='60' y='30' width='5' height='12' rx='2' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <!-- Valve caps (top) -->
  <circle cx='49.5' cy='30' r='3' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='28' r='3' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <circle cx='62.5' cy='30' r='3' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <!-- Valve finger buttons -->
  <circle cx='49.5' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='34' r='2.5' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <circle cx='62.5' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <!-- Valve bottom caps -->
  <circle cx='49.5' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <circle cx='62.5' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <!-- Tuning slide (U-bend below valves) -->
  <path d='M47 62 Q47 72 56 72 Q65 72 65 62' fill='none' stroke='#FFC107' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M47 62 Q47 72 56 72 Q65 72 65 62' fill='none' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Third valve slide -->
  <path d='M67 55 Q74 55 74 62 Q74 69 67 69' fill='none' stroke='#FFC107' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Mouthpiece receiver -->
  <rect x='20' y='47' width='12' height='6' rx='2' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <!-- Mouthpiece cup -->
  <ellipse cx='17' cy='50' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#FFCA28'/>
  <ellipse cx='17' cy='50' rx='3.5' ry='2.8' fill='#E6A800'/>
  <!-- Mouthpiece rim highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='17' cy='50' rx='6' ry='5' fill='none' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Water key (spit valve) on tuning slide -->
  <line x1='58' y1='72' x2='58' y2='78' stroke='#FF8F00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='79' r='2' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <!-- Finger hook -->
  <path d='M38 44 Q36 38 40 36' fill='none' stroke='#FFB300' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Brace from bell to valve block -->
  <line x1='70' y1='45' x2='72' y2='42' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='55' x2='72' y2='58' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Bell interior glow -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='50' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#FFAB00' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Valve casing highlights -->
  <line x1='48' y1='40' x2='48' y2='58' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='40' x2='54' y2='58' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='40' x2='60' y2='58' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Lead pipe highlight -->
  <line x1='32' y1='47.5' x2='66' y2='47.5' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
